allowed_new_data: Fixed source sequence/consumed/valence; role-code and fixed-reason count histograms; aggregate match/sign/count/probability scalars; bound sequence/RNG identifiers; administrative counters. No per-row arrays, raw logits, frames, neural state, checkpoints or source archive payloads.
first_rejection: First encountered production gate only, not every mismatch or new causal credit.
kl: Raw nominal KL from finite normalized log probabilities; negative floating roundoff down to-1e-9 is retained, not clamped or absolutized. Underflow row counts are reported. This is not an exact-real distribution proof.
raw_child_output: Private bounded pipes; never artifact upload. Unknown lines, keys, reasons, counts or nonfinite scalars fail closed.
